Settings

Profile
Defaults to the Apex logo.
To change your subjects or your IGCSE/JEE-NEET track, use Restart App in the sidebar — everything else here can be edited freely.
Saved ✓
Appearance
Pick your own colors for light and dark mode.
Quick actions
A floating ⌘K / Ctrl+K button for jumping between pages. Off by default.
Google Calendar
Connect your Google account so your school's timetable shows up in Week View, styled like the rest of the app. Read-only and one-way — Apex never edits your calendar, and this doesn't change your AI-generated plan.
Advanced: use a different Google Client ID
Already pre-configured — only touch this if told to point it at a different Google Cloud project. Only a Client ID goes here, never a Client Secret.

Log out keeps your data on your account. Delete removes your account and all its data on every device — with a 5-minute delay during which you can cancel.
